Canadian Wheelchair Basketball Teams Aim for Gold at World Championships

Canadian men's and women's wheelchair basketball teams are competing in the 2026 IWBF World Championships, with aspirations of winning gold medals. The coverage highlights the national teams' participation and their pursuit of top honors in the sport. Specific matches mentioned include Canada versus China in the women's championship, and various men's championship games involving Spain, Japan, Brazil, and the Netherlands, as well as Germany versus France in the women's championship. The presence of Saskatchewan athletes on the national team is also noted.
